activity_summary: At breakfast you paid threepence for the fish. Mistress Ansell said two houses alike is no plot, and you would not say who wants what, or a name. Anne's sheet stayed in the chest. You said the King is not begun, and you did not send anyone for a chronicle. The loaf was still a penny and a finger short.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the names upstairs, left the chest shut, and paid threepence.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called alike no plot, and did not ask a second time for the wife's letter.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked which house to pity, and was given the fish instead.

facets.activity: Paid threepence and left Anne's sheet in the chest

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Alike is no plot. Two houses the same is a street with extra chairs.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The page stops before anyone speaks.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Anne's sheet is in the chest. I am not opening that either.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Threepence covers the fish. It does not cover a performance.
